scripts.postinstall: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @gatio/web exec next telemetry disable
scripts.dev: pnpm services && pnpm build:shared && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm --parallel --filter ./apps/* dev
scripts.dev:api: pnpm services && pnpm build:shared && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm --filter @gatio/api dev
scripts.start:web: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @gatio/web build && pnpm --filter @gatio/web start
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:integration && pnpm build
